import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate revenue by region
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
revenue_by_region = df.groupby('region')['revenue'].sum()
target = 100000
remaining = target - revenue_by_region.sum()

# Pie wedges represent each region's contribution and the unfilled target
labels = list(revenue_by_region.index) + ['Remaining to target']
values = list(revenue_by_region.values) + [remaining]
colors = ['#4C78A8', '#F58518', '#D9D9D9']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))
ax.pie(values, labels=labels, colors=colors, startangle=90, counterclock=False,
       autopct=lambda pct: f'{pct:.1f}%' if pct > 0 else '')
ax.set_title('Regional revenue as a share of $100,000 target')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
